pr_title: Fix panes being dropped when tearing off tabs
pr_body:
I don't actually know why this is happening, because it doesn't
happen with startup actions specified in the settings file.
In any case, it's fixed with more delays.

Closes #18572

## Validation Steps Performed
* Create a tab with 2 panes
* Tear it off into a new window
* New window has 1 tab with 2 panes ✅

issue_context.title: Drag tab into new window lost all panels besides the first
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version

Preview 1.23.10353.0

### Windows build number

10.0.22631.0

### Other Software

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

Create two tabs. In the second one split the screen in two panels. Drag this second tab into a new window.

### Expected Behavior

The new window will have both panels. Terminal 1.21.10351.0 works as expected.

### Actual Behavior

The new window have only the terminal in the first panel. From the task explorer, the processes in the lost panels doesn't become detach, they are just killed.
